text:
Nora: Heads-up — Clearlane's renewal is 12 days out. Their usage dropped ~50% month-over-month and AM got a note saying theyre evaluating a cheaper vendor. Opening thread to propose a lightweight save plan. :frowning:
Devon: Got the AM notes. They said API error rate spiked after they turned on streaming. Not a full outage but enough to break a few demo flows.
Priya: Any logs or error codes? We should be specific in communication.
Devon: Error samples show intermittent 502s downstream plus a couple of malformed streaming frames. Example client log: `stream frame parse error: unexpected EOF`
Ruben: Streaming bug could be client-side or runtime. Quick triage: reproduce in a clean environment and try toggling `stream_reassembly=true`. I'll spin a repro container.
Nora: Proposal for a tiered "micro-save" (for low-touch customers):
- 1-week technical stabilization window: experiment with `stream_reassembly=true` + pin to stable model variant.
- 45-minute enablement call (CS + eng) to walk through integration fixes + short perf checklist.
- Conditional renewal incentive: extend trial pricing for 2 more months if they commit by renewal date OR 10% credit if they choose to stay but still downgrade.
Priya: Love the conditional approach. Keeps commercial cost aligned to outcome. Also propose packaging a short self-serve checklist and a tiny test harness we can drop in their repo.
Devon: I can prepare the harness: small node script that hits streaming endpoint with backpressure knobs. Will share by EOD. Snippet:
```
// minimal streaming test
const s = createStreamClient('{API_KEY}');
for (let i=0;i<20;i++) s.send({input: 'ping'});
```
Ruben: Ill run the runtime patch in a canary route for Clearlane only (traffic tag). If stable for 4 hours, promote. I'll post rollback commands before running.
Nora: Who owns customer comms? We need to be transparent but avoid scaring them. Suggest: "We're investigating streaming behavior; propose a short stabilization window and enablement session to validate." Offer dates.
Priya: I'll own comms. Can do draft by tomorrow morning. Also will attach the self-serve checklist and invite them to a 45m slot next week (afternoons ET).
CSBot: Created checklist template: https://rdw-internal/checklists/streaming-stabilize-template. Will send automated reminder 24h before session. :white_check_mark:
Devon: Cost note on conditional incentive: finance OK with 2-month price extension or 10% credit but need sign-off from revenue ops for contracts. I'll loop in Maya after we get customer OK.
Ruben: Execution plan quick steps:
1) Draft comms (Priya) -> send today?
2) Canary runtime patch (Ruben) -> deploy after comms and during agreed window.
3) Share harness + perf capture (Devon) -> attach to session.
4) Enablement session + metrics review (Nora + Eng) -> capture before/after dashboard.
Nora: Timeline: comms today, canary tomorrow morning, enablement within 3 business days.
Priya: Draft done, posting to thread for review now.
Nora: Great. If they accept, we keep this as a documented micro-save play for other low-touch customers. I'll create a short template doc after this. :memo:
Devon: Posting harness link in thread once pushed.
Ruben: Will post the canary rollout plan + rollback command 30m before deploy.
CSBot: Meeting invite scheduled (45m) for Clearlane stabilization: Wed 2pm ET. Reminder will go out.
Nora: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the enablement and capture the survey feedback. If anyone hits blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
